Per-cell co-firing of adjacent IZs

Source: R/izone_adjacency.R
summarise_cell_adjacency.Rd

For each cell, cross-tabulate the fired state of the left and right IZ of every adjacent pair and derive co-firing statistics (p11, expected p_left * p_right, excess, lift, phi, conditional probabilities). The chromosome-shuffle expectation is the expected number of fired adjacent pairs if the cell's fired IZs were placed at random within each chromosome.

Usage

summarise_cell_adjacency(fired, pairs, iz_features)

Arguments

fired

Output of build_firing_matrix()$fired.

pairs, iz_features

make_adjacent_pairs()$pairs and $features.

Value

A data.frame, one row per cell (rows of fired), with the 2 x 2 counts, probabilities and p_expected_chr_shuffle, cofire_lift_chr_shuffle, p_excess_chr_shuffle.
